components.text: ElementOp enters through engaging and can infer the absorbed element from inner runes. It drains concentration outside the array and releases Mana into the interior based on target

pages.text:
• ElementConversionOp drains interior MANA and converts it to a chosen element on an interval.
• ElementVolumeOp uses element volume to affect spatial or projectile volume.
• These operations run on the server so concentration cannot diverge between sides.

$(f:minecraft:uniform)engaging + fire  -> ElementOp(absorbedElement = FIRE)
engaging + water -> ElementOp(absorbedElement = WATER)
MANA in volume  ->$(/f)
